query:
-- Abastecimentos ativos do Galão 1
SELECT id, client_name, liters, ROUND(liters/100, 2) as liters_display, payment_status, asaas_payment_id, created_at
FROM fuel_records
WHERE gallon_number = 1 AND payment_status != 'cancelled'
ORDER BY created_at;

-- Abastecimentos cancelados do Galão 1
SELECT id, client_name, liters, ROUND(liters/100, 2) as liters_display, payment_status, asaas_payment_id, created_at
FROM fuel_records
WHERE gallon_number = 1 AND payment_status = 'cancelled'
ORDER BY created_at;
